findings.highlight: I still hope Saber can defy that simple reality
findings.evidenceJa: あいつなら、必ず覆してくれると信じ
findings.governingReading: In the last second before impact, he acts because he believes Saber will certainly reverse the death that ordinary limits make inescapable.
findings.explanation: Shirou's certainty that Saber will overturn unavoidable death becomes hope that she can do so.

findings.evidenceJa: 文字通り、それは魔法だったのだろう。
findings.governingReading: Seeing Saber break through spatial ripples, Shirou supposes that it probably was ‘magic’ in the ordinary or technical sense.
findings.explanation: A tentative statement that the event was literally magic becomes a categorical identification.

findings.governingReading: Saber breaks through a distortion or ripple manifested in space.
findings.explanation: Ripples in space become ripples in space and time.

findings.highlight: before she can assess the situation, she recognizes me falling at full speed
findings.evidenceJa: この事態に驚くより早く落下する俺を認め
findings.governingReading: Her recognition and rescue precede even her astonishment at suddenly appearing in the schoolyard.
findings.explanation: Saber recognizing Shirou before she can be surprised by the situation becomes recognizing him before she can assess it, with added ‘full speed.’

findings.highlight: I manage to stand on ground
findings.evidenceJa: なんとか地面に降りる
findings.governingReading: After being caught, the bloodied Shirou somehow lowers himself to the ground; only on the next page does he force numb limbs and push himself to his feet.
findings.explanation: Shirou getting down from Saber's hold becomes managing to stand on the ground.

findings.highlight: But there's no time staying down.
findings.evidenceJa: だが倒れてなどいられない。
findings.governingReading: Shirou says he cannot remain down despite his condition.
findings.explanation: ‘No time staying down’ uses a malformed complement.

findings.highlight: Saber is focused only on me
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーはあくまでこちらの身を案じている
findings.governingReading: Saber continues to prioritize his body despite understanding the surrounding crisis.
findings.explanation: Saber's persistent concern for Shirou becomes exclusive focus on him.

findings.highlight: She must have understood my resolve.
findings.evidenceJa: こちらの決意が伝わったのか。
findings.governingReading: He wonders if she sensed his willingness to use another Command Spell.
findings.explanation: Shirou's question whether his resolve reached Saber becomes certainty that she understood it.
